name: ps-vulnscan
description: Scan a codebase for real, exploitable vulnerabilities using secure-coding rule packs matched to its own stack. Detects the technologies in use, proposes the rule packs that apply, downloads them from claude-secure-coding-rules, models the app's identities, roles, tenancy and authorization, then reviews the source against those rules — broken access control and IDOR/BOLA first, then injection, SSRF, deserialization, session and auth flaws. Rule-driven grep-and-read by default, optional semgrep. Produces one consolidated markdown report with CVSS per finding. No external scanner service, no MCP server, no exploitation.
